content: .{@-आननः, -आस्यः, -मुखः, -वक्त्रः@} .²1 epithets of Śiva. .²2 a lion (so called because its mouth is generally wide open; पञ्चम् आननं यस्य), (often used at the end of names of learned men to express great learning or respect; न्याय˚, तर्क˚ <ab>&c.</ab> {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} जगन्नाथतर्कपञ्चानन); see पञ्च {%a.%} .²3 the sign Leo of the zodiac. . ({@-नी@}) an epithet of Durgā.
.{@-मुखः@} an arrow with five points; (for other senses see पञ्चानन.)
